method: Same air-backed2D solver/contact model as AAC. Matched planar subtraction, no soil/ISO13370, cavity radiation or point bridges. Effective P/A number is an authored probe, not regulatory U.

widerCapacityScreen.limit: Full360wide M10/masonry spreader fan and260x450 receiver require actual N/M/shear/positivecontact. No continuing RC/starter through thermalcourse.

decision: Much stronger thermal course than AAC per depth is a credible comparison. It does not earn a whole-envelope selection: retained PE conflicts with current no-synthetic policy and current stock width/RC receiving continuity fails the joined pier application. D1600/half-metre field is NOT selected merely because AAC was weak.
